summary: Fixed feedback incorporation flow by routing replies to done messages as GOAL_FEEDBACK, adding api_key->subscription auth retry in handleGoalFeedback for 401 auth failures, and hardening gIF prompt reply targeting with done-message fallback. Added regression tests for done-message routing and auth fallback. Verified with focused Telegram tests (goal-router, goal-routing, goal-commands) and full src/goal suite; full src/telegram run was attempted but has unrelated pre-existing failures and OOM in this environment.
